text:
Maya: Quick scheduling ask — need a short (30m) design handoff for the new API + SDK + Console model-selection flow. Goal: align API surface, SDK config semantics, and console UX before the RFC. Pre-read: https://docs.google.com/example (please skim before the meeting).
Alex: I can do Tue afternoon or Wed morning. Prefer Wed AM PT.
Raj: Wed 10am PT works for me.
Sophie: Wed morning ok. Would prefer 45m if we need to walk through mockups, but 30m fine for alignment.
Jordan: tagging folks: @Lena for runtime perf, @Raj for SDK, and @Sophie for UX.
Lena: I can cover runtime constraints. Need the expected seq length distribution and a perf target (p95 latency) to bring numbers.
Maya: Good call — perf target: p95 <= 120ms for 2k context on dedicated nodes; bring numbers for 8k as a follow-up.
Maya: Agenda (30m):
  - 5m: Context & goals
  - 10m: API surface + auth changes (Raj/Maya)
  - 8m: SDK config semantics & example usage (Raj)
  - 5m: Console UX quick pass & rollout signals (Sophie)
Pre-read checklist (please paste answers into the doc or thread):
```
- Read doc: API surface diff + SDK proposal page
- Add 1-line compatibility risk if you see one
- Add perf numbers (Lena)
- Attach mockups and accessibility notes (Sophie)
- Call out unanswered UX/SDK decisions we should block on
```
Raj: I'll attach the SDK diff and a short example snippet (how to opt into the new config).
Sophie: I'll upload high-fidelity mockups and a11y checklist by EOD. If we go 30m, I'll keep the walkthrough to the highlights.
Lena: I'll put a perf table for 2k/4k/8k contexts and note any kernel-level implications.
Alex: +1 Wed 10am
Raj: +1 Wed 10am
Sophie: +1 Wed 10am
Lena: +1 Wed 10am
Maya: Great — consensus for Wed 2024-05-08 10:00 PT. I'll send the invite and include the pre-read link + checklist. Please update the doc before the meeting so we can go fast.
calendar-bot: Event created: "Design handoff — API/SDK/Console model-selection" on 2024-05-08 10:00 PT. Attendees: Maya, Alex, Raj, Sophie, Lena, Jordan.
Alex: :thumbsup: See you then.
Maya: Action items recap: Raj attach SDK diff, Lena add perf numbers, Sophie upload mockups + a11y notes. I'll circulate final agenda and attach the meeting notes template.
